original.statement: flux 2.7.0 adds a new `--show-history` flag to the `debug helmrelease` and `debug kustomization` CLI commands.

decision.reason: [ev-e33b9db532e6] says a new `--show-history` flag was added to `flux debug helmrelease`, so the subject is a cli-flag named --show-history and the change type is "added". [ev-63a2c708aad5] adds the same flag to `debug kustomization`. Under the cli-flag family rules both entries give the same assertion. A subcommand doesn't count as a component, and the only binary is the product's own name, which can't go in a field. So treating the cluster as one assertion doesn't merge two different assertions.
